verdict.rationale: Zulip publishes an integrations directory at zulip.com/integrations listing over 130 native, prebuilt integrations, and its bot framework lets admins run existing Zulip bots, so the core catalog exists. The evidence does not show a one-click install or marketplace flow for team-admins. Zapier/IFTTT reach is third-party and is not credited. Missing for 10: documented admin install/enable flow from the directory, marketplace-style listing/management, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can install prebuilt integrations from an app directory or marketplace

citations.quote: You can write and run a custom bot, or run an existing Zulip bot.
